human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Close the current convergence line after 8065-8074 by producing one release-readiness record grounded in direct EverRun acceptance, semantic projection proof, real regression evidence, source-neutral parity and regression-policy audit. This is a freeze/checkpoint pack, not a request for another capability.
human_pressure.why_now: The useful endpoint is a trustworthy, reproducible governance baseline that future work can compare against, not an endless stream of new primitives.
red_lines: No claim of readiness if any required predecessor remains unresolved.

machine_core.goal: Record whether the current Ailuros governance evaluator/regression surface is ready to freeze as the next trusted baseline and enumerate only evidence-backed residual gaps.
invariants: Readiness is derived from predecessor evidence, not pack status alone.
Direct raw producer acceptance is required; wrapper-only proof is insufficient.
At least one real governance regression case and second-producer neutrality evidence are required.
Open defects remain explicit and block a clean readiness claim when materially relevant.

steps.title: Collect predecessor evidence
details: Read outcomes from 8065-8074 and actual code/test state.
Separate implemented, production-proven, synthetic-only and unresolved capabilities.

steps.title: Evaluate readiness gates
details: Require direct raw EverRun audit/import/rebuild success.
Require real regression golden case and source-neutral second-producer parity.
Require regression-policy audit with no unresolved proven contradiction.

steps.title: Write baseline and residual gaps
details: Record a frozen baseline only if gates pass.
Rank remaining gaps by production evidence; do not invent future features.

steps.title: Run final validation
details: Run full repository suite unchanged and record result.

acceptance: Readiness document distinguishes pack-complete from production-proven.
All required gates are backed by concrete evidence.
No production or test changes occur.

producer.artifact: release readiness record grounded in direct EverRun acceptance and governance evidence

observable_effect.assertion: A readiness document distinguishes pack-complete from production-proven, with explicit residual gaps.

proofs.assertion: Readiness document cites concrete evidence; full validation passes.

must_check: 8065-8074 are reviewed from evidence, not filename suffix alone.
Wrapper-only or synthetic-only proof is not mislabeled as production convergence.
A clean readiness claim requires all stated gates.
reject_if: Readiness is declared because packs are done without checking behavioral evidence.
A failed direct producer or regression gate is hidden as expected unknown.
Production/tests are modified in this checkpoint pack.
New primitives or orchestration semantics are proposed as part of acceptance.
